heading.en: These Rules may be cited as the Merchant Shipping (Fees) Rules, Citation and

text.en: When a ship is finally detained or when it appears that a ship provisionally detained was at the time of that detention an unsafe ship, the following survey fees shall be charged, viz :- If the ship is detained on account of overloading, improper loading, unsufficient ventilation of coal cargoes, undermanning or defective equipments, such as chronometers or charts, the fee shall be that prescribed by the scale in paragraph Z(a). If the ship is detained on account of defective hull or machinery, the fee shall be that prescribed by the scale in paragraph Z(b).

The scale of fees fixed by the Minister for cases in which survey is made by direction of a court upon the complaint of the crew of a ship, shall be as follows :-

(a) If the Surveyor is one of the Surveyors of Ships appointed under section 11 of the Enactment, the following shall be the feesGross Tonnage of Ships Amount of Fees $ Under 500 tons 145 500 tons and under 750 tons 175 750 tons and under 1,000 tons zoo For every additional 500 tons 30 (hri .-If the Surveyor is a person appointed for the purpose by the Court under section 133 of the Enactment, the fees shall be as followsGross Tonnage of Ships Amount of Fees $ Under 500 tons 175 500 tons and under 750 tons 230 750 tons and under 1,000 tons 290 For every additional 500 tons 60 The fees do not include any other services whatever.

FEES FOR SURVEY OF SHIPS PRIOR TO CHANGE OF NAME
